services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Experience Whale watching in Hawaii, one of the most popular activities in the winter! Cruise in the comfort of Hawaii’s largest vessel with high-tech stabilizers for smooth cruising and the most outdoor space with four walk-around decks and a top observation deck for optimal whale encounters. Our experienced captains and knowledgeable naturalists share fascinating insights on Humpback whales and Hawaii’s marine wildlife. Our Whale Watch departs January through March from Aloha Tower Marketplace, just 15 minutes away from Waikiki. A whale sighting is guaranteed during the season or you’ll cruise again (transportation optional). Early risers can hop aboard the STAR’s best value Early Bird

services.name: Dinner Cruises
services.desc: Celebrate America's 250th Anniversary this Fourth of July 2026 on Oahu in style with a gourmet dinner, live Hawaiian entertainment and breathtaking views of the sunset and coastline! The Star of Honolulu offers three Independence Day Cruises perfectly-suited to celebrate the Fourth of July in style. Choose from our Nova Five Star, Celebration and Casual Sunset Dinner Show & Fireworks Cruises! The Star of Honolulu welcomes you to a festive evening on the water with our Casual Sunset Buffet, Show & Fireworks Cruise.
